entries.title: Software Projects & Engineering Decisions
entries.description: I'm a Computer Science student working with Java, C#, JavaScript and TypeScript. My personal projects focus on automation, requirements, software testing and AI-assisted development.

entries.title: Digital Core
entries.description: A plugin-based system that automates order handling for a small digital-goods shop on an online marketplace: paid orders, delivery from stock and purchases from external suppliers, with recovery when events are missed.

entries.title: NovaPlatform
entries.description: A full-stack web store for digital goods: a Java/Spring Boot backend serving a plain-JavaScript storefront, customer accounts through Supabase, admin panels and transactional email. Built with AI-assisted implementation.
